changeSet.author: TDuric
changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'api' AND TABLE_NAME = 'ExecutionExternal') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [api].[ExecutionExternal]( [ID] [bigint] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL, [ExternalID] [uniqueidentifier] NOT NULL, [Status] [varchar](250) NOT NULL, [Detail] [nvarchar](250) NULL, [Component] [nvarchar](250) NULL, [CreatedOn] [datetime] NOT NULL, [Configuration] [nvarchar](max) NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_ApiExecutionExternal] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ([ID]) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_Api_ExecutionExternal_component_externalid') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_Api_ExecutionExternal_component_externalid] ON [api].[ExecutionExternal] ([Component],[ExternalID]) END
if not exists (select * from [INFORMATION_SCHEMA].[COLUMNS] where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'api' and TABLE_NAME = 'ExecutionExternal' and COLUMN_NAME = 'Configuration') begin alter table [api].[ExecutionExternal] add [Configuration] nvarchar(max) null end

changeSet.author: Puneet Gupta
changeSet.sql: if exists (select * from [INFORMATION_SCHEMA].[COLUMNS] where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'api' and TABLE_NAME = 'ExecutionExternal' and COLUMN_NAME = 'Detail' and character_maximum_length <= 250 and character_maximum_length > 0) begin alter table api.ExecutionExternal alter column Detail [nvarchar](max) null end
changeSet.rollback: if exists (select * from [INFORMATION_SCHEMA].[COLUMNS] where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'api' and TABLE_NAME = 'ExecutionExternal' and COLUMN_NAME = 'Detail' and character_maximum_length = -1) begin alter table api.ExecutionExternal alter column Detail [nvarchar](250) null end
